'''Torn Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in a [[Torn Station system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The station was connected to the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Quas Killam system/Legends|Quas Killam systems]] through the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]].<ref name="TEA" />

Torn Station served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] stop amidst the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and [[Comet/Legends|comets]] rolling through the surrounding [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Underworld groups such as [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] controlled hideouts on the station.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torn Station was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the station in the grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />
